proposal.title: John Walker represents Autodesk’s organising founders
proposal.reason: John Walker is proposed as the historically plausible founder representative. His authority to sign this alternate-history agreement is a story addition for approval. Adam signs for Logix; the incorporated Autodesk adopts the arrangement in April.

after.name: John Walker
after.description: John Walker represented Autodesk’s organising founders in the January agreement with Logix and coordinated adoption of the arrangement after incorporation.

before.title: Adam funds Autodesk founders and the entire Artemis development environment

action.description: Late-January founders agreement, selected scenario day after the 30 January organizing meeting. Adam supplies each assigned developer an Artemis PRO, the full Team Edition environment, shared build/test/server capacity, qualified storage and backups, toolchains, training and funded engineering support. Begin CAD work using available displays and software graphics fallback; professional 17-inch/800x600 hardware follows around June. November COMDEX is the delivery objective, not a January finished AutoCAD port. Programme details: team_development_program.json.

after.title: Adam funds Autodesk founders and the entire Artemis development environment

action.description: On 31 January 1982, Adam signed for Logix and John Walker represented Autodesk’s organising founders in the funded Artemis development agreement. Logix supplied development systems, software, storage, training and engineering support. The team began CAD work with available displays; the professional display hardware followed in June.

before.title: Autodesk funded development and distribution agreement

party.role: April adopting company; January founders capacity unresolved

before.description: Adam sponsored an Artemis version of AutoCAD and equipped its development team. Autodesk retained ownership of its software and its cross-platform business; Logix supplied hardware, distribution and joint marketing. Autodesk adopted the founders’ January arrangement after incorporation.
